race.comment: SLIDE CITY (6) has a strong record here with three wins and two placings from six starts. Recorded a 3 length win (18.74) in a Grade 5 last time at Q Straight. Rates a leading player. ONLY A DREAMER (8) broke well and quickly mustered speed to win over the 390m at this track two runs back then prominent throughout when finishing second at this track last start. Winning chance. HARA'S JOFFERY (7) has a strong winning strike-rate over this track and trip with two wins and a placing from five tries. In the money last time at Casino (23.81) in a Grade 5, finishing a 4 length third. Looks one of the chances. GOLDSTAR HECTOR (1) can measure up with the right run.
